visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty eight: a fish in my boot (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js campsite at dusk turning to a starry night with pines, a lake, a tent, a campfire with flickering cone flames and a point light, an upturned canoe on stumps, a cooler, a camp chair and a tall tree with a branch over the water, box-built camper with a flannel-check canvas texture, beanie and moustache, climbing poses with the phone held up for signal, a fall into the lake with a splash ring and a floating beanie, a towel after, a fish that drops out of his boot, phone sheets for mail / page not found / deleted post / laptop at home / chat / portfolio box / apply form, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a camping creator is asked for his past work. He has made three videos: one is on an old account (page not found), the brand deleted one, and one is on his laptop at home. No signal, so he climbs the cooler, the canoe, a tree, and sends three links; they ask for one link. He falls in the lake. Then YourBrand: his portfolio sits on his profile, a link or a PDF, set once; when he applies for a deal, the one link is there. No dead links, no trees. There's a fish in his boot. He can stay.
